doc: The opening drop (docs/decisions/0049-drop-height.md, EARLY_CAMPS_DROP.md section 3): the skyship, the squad launch, the dive, the canopy, the landing, and what the local player sees and hears on the way down. Read by DropFeel; DropLaunch, DropReticle, DropSquad, DropView and GliderSfx take their numbers from it. Metres, seconds, m/s, degrees.

ship.doc: height: the ship's flight height (owner call 1; 140 is the grander alternative). speed: along its line. ride_cam_dist / launch_cam_dist: how far back the camera sits aboard and in the launch. plan_s: the planning phase before it sets off.

launch.doc: speed: along the ship's heading. lift: up out of the hatch. lock_s: no keys for this long (45 m carried). separate_after_s: Separate can break you off from here.

dive.doc: fall / speed: the dive's sink and top flat speed. vy_rate: 1/s, how fast it reaches its sink. accel: m/s^2 toward the keys.

canopy.doc: fall / speed / vy_rate / accel: as the dive's, under the open glider. brake: m/s^2 slowing or turning back, dive or canopy. pop_vy: the fall checks to this as the canopy catches. open_h: it opens by itself this high above the ground. void_open_y: and at this height over the void.

flare.doc: Below height the glider flares the fall down to fall, at rate 1/s.

land.doc: The soft landing: dust particles and the model's squash. No ring (a ground ring means gameplay).

hard_landing.doc: A Hard Landing (opening drop only): the dive key held through the last 10 m keeps the canopy shut and you hit the ground at dive speed. Every monster within radius m (not lair bosses, Hunters or Boki) takes damage from you and is stunned stun_s; you move slow_k slower and cannot attack or use abilities for lock_s. The boom carries hear_m and pings rivals' minimaps inside that. Yours only: the camera dips dip_m and springs back over dip_s, with hitstop_s of hit-stop. The ring is drawn at radius for ring_s; dust particles, chunks of chunk_mat (breakables.json debris), a crack crack_m across for crack_s. The reticle shows the hint below hint_h m in the dive. Bots land hard bot_chance of the time when their spot is within bot_camp_m of a live camp.

view.doc: The local player's dive view: the field of view widens by widen_deg over widen_s and the camera tips tilt_deg further down; both ease back over back_s when the canopy opens.

cloud.doc: One cloud sheet at height (world y) for the local player: crossing it is haze_s of white and a whoosh. scale / drift / cover / alpha: the sheet's look (cloud_layer.gdshader).

wind.doc: pitch_low / pitch_high: the wind loop's pitch at a standstill and at the dive's full speed. streak_from: fall speed (m/s) where the screen-edge streaks start; they are full at the dive's fall. snap_db: the canopy's snap in the drop.

ribbon.doc: Each Hunter's team-colour ribbon in the dive: width in metres, trail_s seconds of its velocity long.
